question: Which restaurant/restaurants violated health/food codes most?
output_text:
## Most recorded health/food-code violations

Based on the matched Salt Lake County inspection histories, **Stella Grill** (4291 S 900 E, Millcreek) has the highest recorded total: **123 violations**, including **38 critical violations**. Its most recent inspection score in the dataset is **10**.

### Top 10 by total recorded violations
| Rank | Restaurant | Total violations | Critical violations | Most recent score |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | Stella Grill — Millcreek | 123 | 38 | 10 |
| 2 | Texas Roadhouse — Taylorsville | 113 | 38 | 14 |
| 3 | Burger King — South Jordan | 104 | 28 | 3 |
| 4 | Baskin-Robbins — Salt Lake City | 98 | 25 | 5 |
| 5 | Little Caesars Pizza — Riverton | 95 | 27 | 3 |
| 6 | Arctic Circle — West Jordan | 95 | 27 | 19 |
| 7 | Sagato Bakery & Cafe — Midvale | 88 | 47 | 1 |
| 8 | Cafe Zupas — Salt Lake City | 88 | 23 | 10 |
| 9 | Arctic Circle — Draper | 85 | 24 | 16 |
| 10 | Vessel Kitchen — Midvale | 85 | 28 | 13 |

### Important context
These are **cumulative counts across the inspection history available in this dataset**, not necessarily violations from one visit or a current-condition verdict. Also, only **1.6% (139 of 8,592)** establishments have a matched SLCHD inspection history, so this ranking is limited to those matched records. The chart shows the top 10 by total recorded violations.

**Data-quality note:** inspection-level counts can be inflated where the same violation code was duplicated within an inspection; the dataset flags this as a likely OCR/scraping artifact in some records.

JOIN inspections i ON i.slchd_establishment_key = e.slchd_establishment_key
JOIN violations v ON v.inspection_id = i.inspection_id
GROUP BY e.gmap_id, e.name, e.address
ORDER BY total_violation_count DESC
LIMIT 10
